notes: Two published documents disagree on the IGNITE ceiling: the BIG 13 brochure states CLP 30M (about USD 33K) while the CORFO Ignite 12 call page states a cap of CLP 50.000.000 for line 2. Both are quoted rather than reconciled, because they may be different generations and this session did not read the Ignite 12 legal terms. The larger open question is disbursement: three readings were considered. (a) A foreign individual can receive the money directly, plausible for BUILD because CORFO admits 'personas naturales ... extranjeras' and caps at 90 percent of cost. (b) A Chilean entity is required before any payment, plausible for IGNITE and GROWTH because their eligibility line names a company constituted in Chile with SII activity. (c) A Chilean bank account is required, unverified, nothing read states it. What would settle it: the bases legales for Build 13, not published while the generation table showed 12 as the latest closed round. The next opening is expected around November 2026 because two generations run per year.
